notes.title: Update - 2nd October 2024
notes.notes:
Time Trial Changes
We've been busy making some changes and additions to the first gamemode of Virtual Training Ship - 'Time Trial'. We felt this gamemode needed some more challenge and extra enviromental details to help elevate it and make it more engaging for the player.

Winnie
You're no longer the sole occupier of the house, as Winnie the dog will now follow you around the ground floor. Can you persist with her begging, or will you find her a treat to buy yourself some peace whilst you hunt down the remaining items? 

Safe Puzzle
We've also added a safe puzzle to solve, the player must find the code and interact with the safes keypad to unlock it and access their passport. 

Alongside this we've added some more models and sound effects to the house to help make it feel more lived in. We hope you enjoy this update and as always welcome your feedback.

Best regards,
- Onboard Maritime Team

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Release Date
We are excited to announce the release date of our game Virtual Training Ship (LITE), which will go live on the 7th of September.

About our game
Virtual Training ship (LITE) is an educational game designed for maritime professionals, maritime colleges, academies and those curious about life at sea on a modern ship. The game in its current form will feature three game modes representing different scenarios found on a vessel.

We've spent the last few weeks polishing our game and preparing for its imminent release. Below is some of the content which will be included in Virtual Training Ships' initial release.

Time Trial
Gather all the correct documentation to show you are properly qualified and prepared before you join your ship. You must complete this quickly under a strict time limit before you miss your departure flight!

Free Roam
Board and make yourself familiar with your ship as you explore the deck and engine room. The game contains 'over 50 detailed info boxes' written by maritime professionals that give you a description of some of the critical equipment you will find on a modern vessel. See if you can find them all!

Realistic Interactive Boiler
Complete the challenge of carrying out maintenance of the ship’s boiler under the watchful eye of one of the engineering officers!

In closing, we hope you enjoy our game and find it to be a valuable, educational tool. Please wishlist our game if interested. For any queries please use the community hub or contact us at our linked social accounts. 

Thanks,
- Onboard Maritime Team
